Net replacement (% of the previous year's stock per year)
note: Net replacement rate (demolition net of unconsented additions). Long run 1991–2023: 0.059% per year; 2018–23: 0.173% per year. Each step is one intercensal interval; the 2018–23 step is a single interval. Negative values mean the stock grew by more than consented new building, i.e. more dwellings appeared through conversions and unconsented additions than were demolished. Very High: the interval-length-weighted OLS trend of the census-interval rates 1991–2023, rate = -0.121385 + 6.0725e-05 × year (0.164% in 2026, 0.310% in 2050).
